title: Adopt ui-ux-pro-max via the assimilate human-approve gate (Phase F-5) [HUMAN SIGN-OFF REQUIRED]
description: HARD HUMAN GATE — NOT completable under the unattended preset. Adopt the real third-party ui-ux-pro-max skill (github.com/nextlevelbuilder/ui-ux-pro-max-skill, MIT, pin sha 12b486b22e67f5d887962ef8351c1ac863bfaeb9) into this repo via src/assimilate.js's assimilateSkill, so the FP-4 reconcile path can materialize it. assimilateSkill writes NOTHING unless decision:'approve', and a security-reviewer verdict of 'suspicious' blocks even approve without an explicit securityOverride (addon-packs.md §7 / §82-86; decision-20260708-license-not-safety-content-review-gate). The Orchestrator may PREPARE the approval package autonomously — fetch the skill content at the pinned sha, run the automated risky-pattern scan (shell/exec, network/URL fetch, env/credential access, filesystem access outside the skill dir, obfuscated/base64), and spawn the security-reviewer subagent over the skill's actual instruction text to get a verdict + license classification — and assemble it all into one approval package. But the final decision:'approve' is an explicit HUMAN sign-off that no loop switch lifts; the loop MUST STOP and surface the assembled package for the human to approve/deny (and, if 'suspicious', to explicitly override or reject). Grounds: investigator Phase F memo §4(#3) + §5 FP-5.
acceptance_criteria: The approval package is assembled: license classification (expected MIT/permissive), the automated risky-pattern scan result, and a security-reviewer subagent verdict over the actual skill instruction text — all presented to the human.

assimilateSkill is invoked with decision:'approve' ONLY after an explicit human sign-off (recorded); if the security-reviewer verdict is 'suspicious', approve additionally requires an explicit human securityOverride — never an autonomous override.

On approval, the ui-ux-pro-max skill is materialized under .claude/skills/ui-ux-pro-max (or staged under assimilated-skills/ then reconciled via FP-4), and the integrations lock records the ownership edge.

UAT (human): confirm the skill is present + functional and the lock/provenance is correct. This ticket cannot transition to done without the recorded human approve; uat_delegated_to_orchestrator does NOT lift the assimilate approve gate.

comments.author: uat
comments.body:
UAT — TASK-133 adopt ui-ux-pro-max via the assimilate human-approve gate (verification_tier uat-only). The gate-satisfying HUMAN approve was given explicitly (the human selected \"Approve & vendor\" after reviewing the full approval package). Overall result: PASS.

Step 1 (AC1 — approval package assembled + presented): expect license classification + risky-pattern scan + security-reviewer verdict, all shown to the human. Observed: PASS — package presented: license MIT (permissive, detected from LICENSE file); automated scan = 5 HIGH findings, ALL adjudicated FALSE-POSITIVE by the security-reviewer subagent (4 = design-guidance text in CSV datasets, 1 = benign COLORTERM check); security-reviewer verdict = safe (read SKILL.md + all 4 Python scripts: local CSV search/format only, no network/exec/exfiltration, no prompt-injection). Human reviewed and approved.

Step 2 (AC2 — approve only after explicit human sign-off): expect assimilateSkill(decision:'approve') invoked ONLY after human approval; suspicious verdict would require an explicit securityOverride. Observed: PASS — invoked only after the human's explicit approve; reviewer verdict was 'safe' so no override was needed or used. assimilate returned status:'assimilated', spdx MIT, owner design-power@0.1.0.

Step 3 (AC3 — skill materialized + lock ownership edge): expect the skill live under .claude/skills/ui-ux-pro-max and the integrations lock records the ownership edge. Observed: PASS — reconcilePack (FP-4) materialized .claude/skills/ui-ux-pro-max/ (39 files); integrations.lock.json resources['skill:ui-ux-pro-max'] = {kind:skill, pin 12b486b..., owners:[design-power@0.1.0], scope:project, install_method:assimilated}; SKILL.md carries the provenance block (origin, pin, spdx MIT, source integrity). frontend-design plugin correctly reported Wave-2 (blocking, not installed); reconcile aborted:false.

Step 4 (AC4 — present + functional + provenance correct): expect the skill loadable and provenance/lock correct. Observed: PASS — the Claude Code harness now lists 'ui-ux-pro-max' as an available Skill (materialized copy is live + loadable in-session); fast tier stays green (858 passed/2 skip) with no parity/doc-lock sensor tripped by the new .claude/skills/ entry. Verified by Orchestrator; the gating approve was the human's.

Minor observation (non-blocking, possible follow-up): the lock's integrity is computed over the staged copy (which includes the appended provenance block; 935dd1b6...) while the provenance block records the original-source integrity (fc4c9af8...), and the lock normalizes the origin (drops https://). Expected artifacts of the assimilate-then-materialize flow, not a functional mismatch — flagged for a possible provenance-consistency follow-up.

Overall result: PASS (all 4 ACs). The assimilate path is now proven end-to-end with a real third-party skill adopted through the human-gated flow.
